commits.message:
effects-feel: a sigh catches once on the way in and draws in again (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

A swell is now a list of knots joined by raised cosines; breath and
firefly flash keep their shapes, and the sigh gains its double inhale.
Each part of the sigh's inhale climbs less steeply than a breath, so the
1 fps worst step over an hour stays 0.0395. REACH 0.3 -> 0.27 keeps a
whole-element rest between breaths now a sigh lasts 0.70 of its turn.

fix(table): minimums that do not fit are cut as Rich cuts widths (rich-table-frxv)

When every column's minimum cannot fit, the wrapable columns are narrowed
first, widest first (Rich's _collapse_widths), then the excess is taken from
every column evenly (ratio_reduce), instead of granting minimums in
proportion to natural width. A noWrap label beside a long noWrap column, and
a Progress description beside a fixed-width bar, now lay out as Rich 9d8f9a3.

effects-feel: breath blooms then rests, glints read as passes, fireflies draw a lit stroke, transitions linger in tendrils (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i) (#326)

* effects-feel: breath blooms then rests, glints read as passes, fireflies draw a lit stroke, transitions linger in tendrils (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Pulse turn 43 s with the breath's seconds unchanged, so the bloom from the
heart can visibly spread (REACH 0.3) and the element rests between breaths.
Shimmer band 24 columns either side, so each pass reads as a pass. Fireflies
drift up to 5 cells while lit. Fade 20 s, dissolve 30 s, ordered by
domain-warped noise. Every loop still under the 1 fps step gate over an hour
(worst: pulse 0.039, shimmer 0.036, drift 0.035, sparkle 0.032).

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* effects-feel: a firefly drifts as fast as it is bright; tests run the demo's breath (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Review (high): a dark turn divided by zero in the glide; it now keeps its
length and gives no light. HOP named beside GLIDE; order() builds no closure
per cell; the step-gate comment states the measured 0.039.

* effects-feel: light and wind keep their pace however wide the row (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Review (medium): shimmer and drift crossed the whole span once a period, so a
wider row moved faster — shimmer 0.046 and drift 0.056 per frame at 160-240
columns, over the 0.04 bar. Both now move STRIDE (80) columns a period: the
text line's old pace, the strip slower. Worst hourly step is width-independent
(shimmer 0.031, drift 0.029). drift no longer takes span. A firefly's stroke
scales with its brightness, so dim flashes no longer streak fastest. The step
gate now watches a 240-column element too.

* effects-feel: one swell, softer ink, shimmer passes worked out once a frame (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Review (high, escalation): given() integrates swell() itself rather than a
hand copy of its shape; order() back to three octaves, the fourth sat near
per-cell and speckled the fade's tendrils; shimmer's passes are computed once
per moment, not once per cell. Stale once-a-period docs and test name fixed;
the step-gate comment says what run measured 0.0395.
